title: After the Iowa Detonation, a Family Gathered for an Unusual Thanksgiving
summary: A family came together at a farmhouse in southeast Iowa the day after the explosion at an ammunition plant. It felt as if a storm had passed.
caption: From left: Janice Johnston-Jones, Holly Jones, Lily Gesling, Laura Mincer, Vivian Stogdill and Kaitlin Stogdill celebrated Thanksgiving together in Crawfordsville, Iowa.

title: A City Fears the Loss of Its Pier After a Section Collapsed Into the Sea
summary: The famed pier in Pacifica, Calif., had long been crumbling. This week, a portion of it succumbed to fierce waves and toppled into the sea.
caption: Waves pounded the pier in Pacifica, Calif., after a portion of it collapsed during high surf and tides on Wednesday.

title: On the Thanksgiving Menu for National Weather Service Meteorologists
summary: National Weather Service meteorologists keep their offices running all year, even on weekends and holidays. Here’s what was on the menu over a wet and gusty Thanksgiving.
caption: Alex Sizemore, a meteorologist at the National Weather Service’s office in Mt. Juliet, Tenn., watching a football game while monitoring the weather on Thanksgiving night.

summary: The administration’s increasing focus on far-left terrorist groups has left many counterterrorism experts confounded.

title: The Threat to a Sanctuary for Children of North Korean Defectors
summary: A school in Seoul caters to students whose parents fled North Korea. Neighbors want it gone, and students say it is just one example of the prejudice they face in the South.
caption: Students running laps with teachers before lunch at Yeomyung School in Seoul in November.
